get_cfg: get a copy of the default Timesformer config with all validated settings
assert_and_infer_cfg: assert and validate a Timesformer config node for BN, TRAIN, TEST, RESNET, and solver settings
configure_bn: configure batch norm options including norm type, weight decay, and precise stats
configure_solver: configure the optimizer solver with learning rate policy, momentum, weight decay, and warmup settings
configure_timesformer: configure Timesformer model options including attention type and pretrained model path
